building: A residential building: an 8-storey apartment building on a city street - three flats and the entrance lobby on the ground floor, two basements of parking under the whole plot, balconies on the west (street) and east facades
principles: Stage it as it will be lived in: the facades carry plants and a few people; the ground floor is furnished where the architect drew it.
Every piece of ground-floor furniture stands on the architect's own 2D symbol: its place and size are his, never invented.
Light porcelain floors, white kitchens with a warm quartz top, oak tables, linen sofas; one colour per flat on the beds (teal, rust, sage).
Outside: the trees the architect keeps and plants, at his points; a grey sidewalk and the asphalt of the street; lawns and decks as modelled.
